# Third-party licenses

## mp4-muxer

MIT License. Copyright (c) 2023 Vanilagy.

The file `mp4-muxer.js` is the browser build of [mp4-muxer](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mp4-muxer) 5.2.2, used to wrap WebCodecs H.264 samples in an MP4. It is included so video export stays on the static site with no network call.

## webm-muxer

MIT License. Copyright (c) 2023 Vanilagy.

The file `webm-muxer.js` is the browser build of [webm-muxer](https://github.com/Vanilagy/webm-muxer) 5.1.3, used to wrap WebCodecs VP8 and VP9 samples in a WebM. It is included so video export stays on the static site with no network call.

## gifenc

MIT License. Copyright (c) 2020 Matt DesLauriers.

The file `gifenc.js` is [gifenc](https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc) 1.0.3, used for client-side GIF export.
